description: The tornado chart that actually does sensitivity analysis. Give it the output at each driver's low and high input and the base case: bars swing around the base, the widest swing goes on top, and each driver's assumptions (€620/t, 3 months, 7.5%) sit at the bar ends. Unlike two-measure butterfly visuals, it anchors the bars at your base case. The same visual draws butterfly charts, population pyramids and diverging stacked bars - the chart type follows your fields. Free features: Sensitivity tornado with up to 5 drivers: base line with label, swing sort, input assumptions with per-driver units, change vs base in value or %, swing column, materiality threshold Colour by effect (worse or better than base, with a lower-is-better switch for costs) or by input (low or high), optional hatching so direction never depends on colour alone Inverse drivers and drivers with both results on one side of the base are drawn correctly Butterfly and population pyramid in full: two measures or one measure split by a field, category labels in the centre spine, % of grand total, of each side or of each row, winner emphasis, independent scales per side Age bands split by Male / Female draw as a population pyramid on the first drop: oldest band on top, men on the left (or pick the Pyramid sort for any banded data) Diverging stacked bars: losses left of zero, gains right, net marker - or survey…
